{{Quote|[&hellip;] ''to this day one occasionally sees this script used in military contexts with little attention paid to its sinister origins. Military bunkers on Storinal and Hanod, New Republic task forces, and even a few Ordnance/Regional Depot worlds such as Ord Dalet were identified by Common Sith letters.''|italics=0|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>}}
'''Ord Dalet''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]. It was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] established no earlier than the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]] and was named after the letter "[[dalet]]" from the [[Common Sith]] [[Writing/Legends|writing system]]. Around [[3638 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Shi'ido (Ord Dalet)|member]] of the [[Shi'ido]] [[Species/Legends|species]] became [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitalized]] on Ord Dalet.

==Description==
Ord Dalet was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Shifting Treatment" /> located in the [[Ord Dalet system/Legends|Ord Dalet system]], a part of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
Ord Dalet was an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]<ref name="Written" /> [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Republic" /> at some point no earlier than the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Old Sith Wars]],<ref name="Written" /> which lasted between [[3996 BBY]] and [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="OSWdates">{{CSWECite|II|407|Old Sith Wars}} establishes that the [[Old Sith Wars]] included both the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the Great Sith War to [[3996 BBY]] and the [[Battle of Rakata Prime|end]] of the Jedi Civil War to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> As a consequence of defections and counter-defections between the [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] of the Republic and those employed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] during that time, letters of the [[Common Sith]] [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] came into use by the Republic's military, and Ord Dalet became one of several Ordnance/Regional Depots designated by them&mdash;in its case, the letter "[[dalet]]." That fact was eventually noted by the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] in her [[38 ABY]] publication "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]."<ref name="Written" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel}}
Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}. According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] take place in [[3638 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Shifting Treatment" is part of the ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' expansion and therefore also takes place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Shi'ido (Ord Dalet)|member]] of the [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Shi'ido]] [[Species/Legends|species]] became hospitalized on Ord Dalet. Due to the biological extraordinarity of the Shi'ido, an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] subsequently sent a companion to assist in the study and treatment of the patient.<ref name="Shifting Treatment" />
{{Endgame}}

==Locations==
Ord Dalet had a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]].<ref name="Shifting Treatment" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The occasional use of letters (Common Sith or otherwise) for Ordnance/Regional Depots, is new information, as is the example given. Some may wonder at the creation of new O/RDs after the Old Sith Wars, given ''The Essential Atlas''{{'s}} hinting that they were created during the term of Chancellor Contispex and the Pius Dea Crusades; however, O/RDs were still being created as late as the Clone Wars when, as ''Pirates & Privateers'' notes, Ord Antalaha was established.|John Hazlett|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|JSarek|8|Endnotes for The Written Word}}</ref>}}
Ord Dalet was introduced in the article "[[The Written Word]]," which was authored by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Written" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ord Dalet [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square R-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
